quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 earnings deck, Business Metrics slide (page 5): of the 248 exabytes shipped in Q1 FY2027, Nearline was 223 exabytes and Non-Nearline 25; over the prior four quarters Nearline exabytes were 183 (Q1 FY26), 192 (Q2 FY26), 199 (Q3 FY26) and 209 (Q4 FY26), and Non-Nearline 21, 23, 23 and 22. The call gave only the 248-exabyte total.
quarterly_data.figure: Nearline 223 exabytes, Non-Nearline 25 exabytes of 248 in Q1 FY27 (Nearline 183 in Q1 FY26, 209 in Q4 FY26)

quarterly_data.quarter: Western Digital IR presentation: 5. Q1'27 Earnings Deck vFinal (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 earnings deck, cash flow and capex (pages 3, 6 and 10): cash flow from operations $1,604 million, up 139% year over year (Q4 FY26 $1,389 million); purchases of property, plant and equipment, net were $227 million in Q1 FY2027 versus $108 million in Q4 FY2026 and $73 million in Q1 FY2026; free cash flow $1,377 million at a free cash flow margin of 31.4%. GAAP results: gross margin 57.8%, operating margin 46.7%, net income $1,779 million and diluted EPS $4.63 (non-GAAP $4.64). The deck also states Western Digital is 'Ramping next generation ePMR platform'.
quarterly_data.figure: operating cash flow $1,604 million (+139% YoY); PP&E purchases $227 million (Q4 FY26 $108 million, Q1 FY26 $73 million); FCF margin 31.4%; GAAP EPS $4.63
